gap: No result ChatGPT got states the total cost of the DIY route against a dedicated feeder that has free AI bird ID: the $47.99 Wasserstein case is only $52.00 cheaper than Birdfy's $99.99 feeder, which needs no plan. No result works out how far each camera's free storage goes at a feeder either: a Wyze card holds about 32 days of looping video, and the Blink app lists about 33 clips a day.
standout_why: I read the cited Wyze page 'Is 24/7 Local Recording going away?' and the cited Blink pages 'Local Storage with Sync Module' and 'Blink Storage Options'. They give no capacity or cost figures. Blink says only that capacity 'depends on your USB drive or MicroSD card size'. Two uncited results give the raw inputs and nothing more. Wyze's 'How do Cam Plus and a microSD card compare' says 'up to 4 days with 32 GB'. Blink's 'Sync Module 2 FAQ' has the 1,000-clip, 30-day display cap. None of these pages works out days on the largest supported card or clips per day. None prices the DIY setup against a dedicated feeder. ChatGPT's answer says you 'don't need to buy a dedicated bird feeder camera' but gives no cost.
decides: Wyze owner (Cam v3, v3 Pro, OG or Outdoor): the case plus a microSD card is the cheapest path. It loops about 32 days of continuous video on a 256 GB card, so the DIY build makes sense. Blink owner without a Sync Module 2 or XR: the hub is an extra purchase on top of the $47.99 case, which eats into a $52.00 gap. Blink storage also stops recording when the drive fills, and the app lists only about 33 clips a day. In that case the $99.99 Birdfy Feeder, with free AI ID and 30-day cloud storage, is the stronger pick. That gap holds only while Birdfy's $99.99 price (list $259.99) lasts.

findings.label: Clips the app lists without a subscription
findings.value: first 1,000 clips from the past 30 days
findings.note: Blink: 'only the first 1000 clips are displayed from the past 30 days of activity'. To see the rest, you plug the drive into a computer. Drive limits are 1 GB to 256 GB, and the drive counts as full below 375 MB free.

findings.label: Derived: clips per day the app can list over a month
findings.note: 1,000 clips ÷ 30 days = 33.3 clips/day. A feeder that triggers more often than that will show only part of the month in the app.

findings.label: What happens when the USB drive fills
findings.value: recording to the drive stops (no loop overwrite)
findings.note: Blink: 'you are alerted, and nothing more is written to the drive'. The Blink Storage Options page agrees: new recordings stop until space is freed. Wyze's card loops instead.

findings.label: Local storage support
findings.value: Yes, with Sync Module 2 (USB) or Sync Module XR (microSD); not with Sync Module Core
findings.note: Blink Storage Options also says Sync Module Core doesn't support local storage. Many Outdoor 4 kits ship with Core, so those owners need to buy a second hub.
